<!-- Follow docs/pr-description.md. Remove prompts that do not apply. -->

## Background and result
What problem does this solve, and what behavior changes? Add a short before/after example when useful.

## Scope and changes
Name affected skills or repository components. Describe changes by behavior and any compatibility impact. Include API fields, data structures, or callers only when touched.

## Validation
List checks actually run and their results. Note any meaningful validation limit, such as no live API check or no installed-skill check.

## Publication status
Is this repository source only, or has a separate publication step occurred? Name pending ClawHub sync or release actions when relevant.

<!-- For a major upgrade: explain data flow, layer ownership, design choices, old/new compatibility, migration order, caller impact, and rollback. -->

## Related issue
<!-- Link an issue if applicable; use Closes # only when this PR resolves it. -->

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist
- [ ] I reported the applicable checks and their results
- [ ] I have updated documentation if needed
- [ ] I checked the affected skill's responsibility map if a skill changed
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
